text.title: 绘画桌旁
text.situation:
画室里有纸和新铅笔的气味。一个孩子在画中心的门，另一个望着外面的队伍。玛雅真心对他们的画感兴趣；她问那些小形状表示什么，而没有说每张画都完美。一位叫露丝的友善志愿者为一位家长拉出备用椅子。她说话很温和，家长很快不再担心自己能否参与。

绘画桌
儿童活动需要家长看护。
请向露丝领取纸和铅笔。
完成的画请放在晾干架上。

家长：我能坐在她旁边吗？我不想过多干涉。
露丝：当然。让她自己选颜色，需要时再问她要不要帮助。
玛雅：谢谢你为我们腾地方。
露丝：还能再放一把椅子。
窗边，一位年长访客展示运河速写。他的画似乎启发一个孩子开始画自己的作品。

paragraphs.en: The studio smelled of paper and new pencils. One child was drawing the centre’s door while another was watching the queue outside. Maya felt genuine interest in their pictures; she asked what the little shapes meant instead of saying every picture was perfect. An amiable volunteer named Ruth pulled out a spare chair for a parent. She spoke so warmly that the parent soon stopped worrying about joining in.

paragraphs.en:
Drawing table
Children’s activities require parental supervision.
Ask Ruth for paper and pencils.
Please leave finished pictures on the drying shelf.

请向露丝领取纸和铅笔。
完成的画请放在晾干架上。

paragraphs.en:
Parent: Can I stay beside her? I do not want to interfere.
Ruth: Of course. Let her choose the colours, and ask if she wants help.
Maya: I appreciate you making space for us.
Ruth: There is room for one more chair.
By the window, an older visitor showed a sketch of the canal. His picture seemed to inspire a child to begin a drawing of her own.

S11.O03.P01.cue: 描述玛雅的兴趣和露丝的态度。
acceptableAnswers: 玛雅真心感兴趣。露丝和气，让访客感到受欢迎。

S11.O03.P02.cue: 解释告示和家长的顾虑。
acceptableAnswers: 活动需要家长看护，但家长不想过多干涉。

S11.O03.P03.cue: 感谢露丝，并说明速写带来的启发。
acceptableAnswers: 谢谢你找来椅子。速写启发一个孩子画画。

S11.O03.T01.cue: 感谢留下来帮助你的人。
